description: This is a Java test class for the Fineract project that verifies the correctness of the loan repayment schedule calculation for monthly loans with various seed dates. It includes setup routines, multiple test methods for different starting dates, and helper methods for creating clients and loan products.

classes.name: LoanApplicationScheduleMonthlyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the monthly loan repayment schedule calculation based on different seed dates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured, request and response specifications, and helper objects before each test.

methods.name: validateSeedDate31
methods.description: Tests the calculation of repayment schedule starting on 31st January, checking the due dates for each month.

methods.name: validateSeedDate30
methods.description: Tests the repayment schedule starting on 30th January, verifying due dates across months.

methods.name: validateSeedDate28
methods.description: Tests schedule starting on 28th January with expectations for month-end due dates.

methods.name: validateSeedDate25
methods.description: Validates the schedule starting on 25th January, ensuring due dates align with calendar dates.

methods.name: createLoanProductEntity
methods.description: Creates a new loan product with specified parameters for testing.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Submits a loan application for a given client and loan product, returning the loan ID.
